svg.aria-label: Projects: Continuity Connect (Healthcare · Aged care): One platform for care providers to plan care, document, schedule and stay compliant across organisations. Family Health Hub (Healthcare): HIPAA-compliant appointment booking and management for patients, professionals and services. AiVisor (Automotive): Vehicle service scheduling for car dealerships: book, update and cancel through Xtime. SafeSphere (QHSE management): Safety and compliance reporting for oil & gas, construction and manufacturing. IHG (Hospitality): Scalable MuleSoft APIs for InterContinental Hotels Group.
